scope: Pixel review of the supplied hero and mobile-preview assets only. This does not admit article prose, establish source freshness, or publish any asset.

findings.evidence: The paper-plan composition separates a neighbourhood model and a server-building model while routing both to one substation. The two blank binders support a planning/cost-allocation reading. It shows neither enacted law nor a changed household bill.
No falling bill, savings arrow, price claim, approved stamp, signature, official insignia, generic robot, or numerical consumption comparison is visible.
No readable words, pseudo-readable labels, people, character likenesses, or anatomy are visible.

Models, folders, writing tools, desk and substation are coherently supported. At mobile size, the neighbourhood, server building, common substation and distinct cyan/tangerine routes remain identifiable.
Hero uses the approved adult editorial pop-art language: inked comic detail, print/halftone texture, dark navy field, magenta and cyan accents, and purposeful still-life composition.

limitations: This review found no pixel repair. It does not validate the producer contract metadata that still labels the stage PRE_RENDER or says no image has been generated; those record-state statements are outside this pixel verdict and require separate producer-record reconciliation before binding.
No live NewsStand crop, accessibility implementation, prose admission, or publication review was performed.
nextAction: Eligible for the next non-visual gate only after the producer reconciles its stale contract record-state fields; no visual regeneration is required by this review.
